title: Google Maps 助你开启美食之旅的三大新功能
author: The Keyword (blog.google)
content:
Looking for your next great meal? In addition to our Fan-Favorite Dining List, check out these three Google Maps features to discover the best spots anytime.

  1. 🧁 Use Ask Maps to find and order what you’re craving: Just say or type what you want — like "fall dessert spots with outdoor seating" or "crispy smashburgers with milkshakes." Ask Maps analyzes billions of photos, reviews, and menus to find your match, and even lets you order delivery through partners like Uber Eats, Toast, and Square.
  2. 📈 Explore trending dining lists: Check out the Explore tab for dining lists updated weekly to make sure you never miss out on the next big restaurant. You’ll find places that have recently spiked in popularity in the 🔥Trending list, new neighborhood favorites in the 💎 Gems list, and tried-and-true classics in the 🏆 Top list. Save them with a tap to build your ultimate dining bucket list.
  3. 🔍 Check "know before you go" tips: Avoid surprises by checking for insider tips from the Maps community when you search for restaurants, cafes, diners and more. Just scroll down the page to find info on how to snag a coveted reservation, where to park, what dishes to order, and more.

Ready to eat? Open Google Maps, try out these features, and see what you uncover for your next night out.
aiSummary: Google Maps 推出三项新功能——支持自然语言搜索与点餐的「Ask Maps」、热门餐厅榜单以及社区提供的「行前须知」小贴士，旨在提升餐厅发现体验。
oneSentenceSummary: Google Maps 推出三项新功能——支持自然语言搜索与点餐的「Ask Maps」、热门餐厅榜单以及社区提供的「行前须知」小贴士，旨在提升餐厅发现体验。
summary: 这则简短的公告重点介绍了 Google Maps 旨在优化餐饮探索体验的三项特定功能。首先，「Ask Maps」允许用户使用自然语言进行搜索（例如“秋季甜点好去处”），并整合了 Uber Eats 等外卖合作伙伴以支持直接下单。其次，“探索”标签页现在提供每周更新的分类列表，包括 Trending（热门）、Gems（宝藏）和 Top（顶级）餐厅，帮助用户发现人气店铺或隐藏佳作。第三，新增的「行前须知」板块在餐厅详情页中直接提供由社区贡献的内部贴士，涵盖预订、停车及菜单推荐等信息。

mainPoints.explanation: 「Ask Maps」功能利用 AI 解读关于食物偏好和氛围的复杂对话式查询，从基于关键词的搜索转变为语义理解。

mainPoints.point: 通过热门榜单实现动态发现
mainPoints.explanation: 通过策划每周更新的 Trending（热门）、Gems（宝藏）和 Top（顶级）餐厅列表，Google Maps 旨在减少决策疲劳，并突显当地餐饮场景中的实时流行趋势变化。
新增的「行前须知」贴士汇总了用户生成的关于停车和预订等后勤问题的建议，增强了标准商家列表的实用性。

keyQuotes: Ask Maps 分析数十亿张照片、评论和菜单以找到适合你的选择
搜索餐厅时查看来自 Maps 社区的内部贴士，以避免意外情况
